title: Nazca Lines Water Theory

scenes.text: Hundreds of lines may have guided ancient irrigation
The geoglyphs stretch across the Nazca Desert in southern Peru
A 2015 LIDAR survey detected subtle channels beneath several lines

description: While the Nazca Lines are famous for their giant drawings, new data hints they could have been a massive water‑management system. Dive into the evidence.
